name: Acceleration Gate
blurb: Active:  Jayce deploys an energy gate centered at the target location for a few seconds. All allied champions that touch the gate will gain a burst of  movement speed.

effects.description: Active: Jayce deploys an energy gate centered at the target location, lasting for 4 seconds and granting sight of its surroundings. Jayce and allied champions can move through the gate to gain bonus movement speed that decays over 3 seconds, with the duration refreshing continuously while within the gate.
